name: blackbox-border-status
description: Show Codex turn activity and completion notifications in the owning Black Box window.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex terminal activity and completion.
interface.longDescription: Pulses the owning Black Box window border while a Codex turn runs, marks completion in lime, and sends a notification that focuses the owning terminal window when clicked.
defaultPrompt: Show Codex activity in Black Box.
